title: gametooltip
summary: MSUI now has one shared tooltip lifecycle and immutable renderer for the implemented content channels while existing presenters remain protected. Item snapshots reproduce the current reference's signable/conjured/binding/unique/quest/locked and slot/type order, server-fed proficiency and Dual Wield cell colors, damage/speed/DPS, stat/resistance/enchant/durability order, class/race/level/skill/spell/reputation requirements, known-recipe warning, substituted Use/Equip/Chance-on-hit rows, real charge pools, random-enchant placeholder, full ItemSet membership/bonus block, wrapped flavor text, creator, and open/read tails. Positioned inventory/inspect item hovers use a frozen slot-side seat, exact FrameXML tooltip fonts, independent right cells, classic padding/logical-row gaps, wrapped physical-line measurement, tinted tooltip art and screen clamp. The packet remains live-unverified: no physical owner race, live unit sequence, or pixel equivalence is claimed.
